tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the two-layer siphon family, but the pilot varies only u_now. A discriminating open-branch probe can identify the sink-gradient dependence and distinguish competing branch terms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the thermal-fin siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and the branch contribution are not independently identified.
The thermal-fin and flux-conservation signatures point first to a static siphon bridge; a trajectory batch is less targeted to the present ambiguity.
It does not resolve the sink-gradient or branch ambiguity.
